luna_triage.reason: The article explicitly conceptual-replicates Mischel and Shoda’s longitudinal work and cites the 1988 paper as one of three foundational studies. But supplied row 484 is Shoda et al. 1990, another distinct paper on the same longitudinal findings/cohort; supplied text explicitly attributes relevant age-15 associations and diagnostic-condition claims to 1990. It is unresolved whether candidate 1988 identifies a distinct retested finding or conflates related reports. Needed: scope adjudication linking tested outcomes to the particular 1988 versus 1990 report.
